Month-to-Month Rental Agreement (template)

A rolling tenancy with no fixed end date, renewing each month until either party gives notice. Replace every [BRACKETED] value and adjust for your state. Not legal advice — see DISCLAIMER.

MONTH-TO-MONTH RENTAL AGREEMENT

This Agreement is made on [DATE] between [LANDLORD NAME] ("Landlord") and [TENANT NAME(S)] ("Tenant") for the property at [PROPERTY ADDRESS] (the "Premises").

1. Term. The tenancy begins [START DATE] and continues month to month until terminated as below.

2. Rent. $[AMOUNT] per month, due on the [DAY] of each month.

3. Termination. Either party may end this Agreement by giving at least [# DAYS — commonly 30; check your state] written notice. See notice to vacate.

4. Rent changes. Landlord may change rent with [# DAYS] written notice, subject to local rent-control rules.

5. Security deposit. $[AMOUNT], returned within [# DAYS] of move-out less lawful deductions.

6. Utilities / Maintenance / Pets / Entry. [Same structure as a standard lease — fill per your situation].

7. Required disclosures. [Insert state/federal disclosures — see ../state-notes/state-considerations.md]

8. Governing law. Laws of [STATE].

Landlord: __________________ Date: ______
Tenant: __________________ Date: ______
